Name: Alternate Mining Animation
Author: Hithae
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Alternate Mining Animation[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
Tired of the goofy-looking jump that happens when you use some tools sideways? Look no further![/center]

[center][b]VANILLA (UNMODDED)[/b]
[img width=320,height=320]https://media.giphy.com/media/jZ8QZX8zmO7ed1TTwN/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]MOD (NO NOSE)[/b]
[img width=320,height=320]https://media.giphy.com/media/OipP0J2gvOdZv8fDov/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]MOD[/b]
[img width=320,height=320]https://media.giphy.com/media/lPIqKV3pYTd0MwQ6ci/giphy.gif[/img][/center]

[left][size=4]Compatibility:[/size] [size=3]This mod is compatible with all mods that don't change the same specific animation, as well as the pants/skirts/shorts/etc sprites used for the same animation.[/size][/left]
[size=3][size=3] I'll do everything within my limited power to fix bugs and to accomodate requests as far as possible. Enjoy![/size][/size]


Big thanks to the official Stardew Valley Discord server for their guidance and support!

Manifest.Name: Alternate Mining Animation
Manifest.Description: Replaces the side-on animation for mining (animation from the front and back remain untouched)
